# Design System (AI SaaS Agent)

> Extreme-minimal design system for AI agent products. Geist-inspired: no shadows,
> 1px borders, radius 2/4/6px, Pretendard font, brand blue #1F7FF0 (light) / #4593F5 (dark),
> Radix Slate gray scale 1-12. Light + dark themes via [data-theme="dark"].

## Rules for AI code generation
- Use ONLY CSS variables from ds.css (var(--gray-3), var(--brand), ...). Never hardcode hex colors.
- Gray roles: 1-2 backgrounds, 3-5 hover/disabled, 6-8 borders, 9-11 secondary text, 12 body text.
- Brand color only for primary actions, selection, focus, links. Backgrounds/borders stay neutral.
- No box-shadow except Toast and floating overlays.
- One .btn-primary per screen.
- Every async surface shows PROGRESS (toolcall/thinking), not a bare spinner.
- Every component must handle: default, loading, empty, error states.
- Component names are English; UI copy may be Korean.

## Components (all in ds.css, copy markup from index.html)
Core: Button(.btn -primary/-secondary/-ghost/-danger/-sm), Input(.field/.input/.hint),
Badge(.badge +brand/success/danger), Chip(.chip), Avatar(.ds-avatar sm/lg/brand, .avatar-group),
Card(.card), Divider(.divider, .divider-label), Skeleton(.skeleton text/circle),
Toast(.toast success/danger), Table(.table-wrap), EmptyState(.empty)
Agent: ChatMessage(.msg/.avatar/.msg-body), StreamingText(.cursor), ThinkingIndicator(.thinking),
ToolCallStep(.toolcall + .spinner|.check), AgentInput(.agent-input), CitationChip(.cite),
ArtifactPanel(.artifact), SearchResult(.sresult), FileGrid(.file-grid/.file-card),
FileRow(.file-row)

## Templates (golden screens — clone these to start a new page)
- templates/chat.html — agent chat: sidebar, message stream, tool calls, citations, composer
- templates/search.html — search: query bar, filter chips, highlighted results, empty state
